heading_initialization: outgoing segment at nodes 0..6; last incoming segment at node 7; reject invalid initial segments
graph_coordinates: 8 editable SE2 poses in a local additive x,y,unwrapped-yaw chart about observation-anchored FRESH; B51 fixed
rigid_rule: unique left SE2 transform mapping initial pose F0 (XY and derived heading) onto B51; preserve all relative transforms
corrected_controller_input: corrected world index2 expressed in the fixed B51 local frame
safety_note: fixed 5mm reserve above the unchanged 20mm pass threshold for soft penalties; not a hard feasibility guarantee
native_safety: hinge for all seven future segments plus B51->X0 against all three AABBs, circular footprint; corridor hinge at B51 and all future points
controller_safety: hinge on minimum conservative swept clearance of original-PD fixed-command rollout over 16 exact integration ticks, per obstacle; also minimum corridor clearance
se2_residuals: Log(Fj^-1 Xj), Log(Zj^-1 (Xj^-1 Xj+1)), Log(B51^-1 X0), where Zj=Fj^-1 Fj+1; rotation wrapped to [-pi,pi)
heading_consistency: pose yaw versus actual outgoing XY tangent (last node incoming), with a short-segment hinge; invalid final tangents reported, never native yaw
objective: 0.5 * sum(squared normalized residuals), linear loss; no robust loss or result-dependent weights

solver.initialization: zero increments from original observation-anchored FRESH poses

input_firewall: Only prediction50/51 sample0, their observation poses, B51 and geometry active at B51 enter the solve. OLD50 is context/plot only, no index correspondence factor. Future actual trace and stored baseline results enter post-solve validation/comparison only.
evaluation: original PD + integrate_se2 + swept_clearance + corridor_clearance; native full/prefix separate from rollout; same 16 ticks for all three methods
scope: one offline optimization; no navigation, inference, closed-loop planner, reranking, new correspondence or environment changes
